blocks.title: Colors of Support Solidarity Ribbons
blocks.lead: Colors of Support is a campus-wide ribbon initiative by Badger Supports that brings visibility, connection, and care to UW–Madison. Each ribbon represents a different cause or experience—from mental health and recovery to pride, advocacy, and awareness.
body: By picking up and wearing a ribbon, you show solidarity and remind others they are not alone. Display it on your backpack or jacket!
Free ribbons are available at the Student Mental Health Hub, the Student Activity Center, and at some Badger Supports events. More pickup locations coming soon!
